# dodopayments_entitlement (Resource)

Manages a entitlement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dodopayments_entitlement" "example" {
  integration_config = {
    feature_id   = "example-entitlement"
    feature_type = "boolean"
  }
  integration_type = "feature_flag"
  metadata = {
    tier = "pro"
  }
  name = "example-entitlement"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_config` (Attributes) Platform-specific configuration (validated per integration_type). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config))
- `integration_type` (String) Which platform integration this entitlement uses. A change to this value destroys the resource and creates a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name for this entitlement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Additional metadata for the entitlement.

### Read-Only

- `business_id` (String) Identifier of the business that owns this entitlement.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the entitlement was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the entitlement.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Always `true` for entitlements returned by the public API;
soft-deleted entitlements are not returned.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the entitlement was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config`

Optional:

- `activation_message` (String) Optional message displayed when a customer activates the license
key (≤ 2500 characters). If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `activations_limit` (Number) Maximum activations allowed per issued license key. Omit for unlimited. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `chat_id` (String) Telegram chat ID. For groups this is typically a negative integer. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `duration_count` (Number) Validity duration of issued license keys. Provide both
`duration_count` and `duration_interval` together for a fixed
duration; omit both for non-expiring keys. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `duration_interval` (String) Unit of `duration_count`. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `external_url` (String) Optional external URL shown to the customer alongside the files.
- `feature_id` (String) Merchant-chosen identifier for the capability this entitlement
unlocks. Not unique across entitlements. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `feature_type` (String) Type of capability conferred. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `figma_file_id` (String) Figma file identifier to grant access to. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `framer_template_id` (String) Framer template identifier to grant access to. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `fulfillment_mode` (String) How license keys are fulfilled. `auto` (default) generates and delivers
keys to customers automatically; `manual` creates pending grants that you
fulfill with the supplied key via `POST /grants/{grant_id}/license-key`. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `guild_id` (String) Discord guild (server) ID. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `instructions` (String) Optional human-readable delivery instructions shown to the customer
alongside the files.
- `notion_template_id` (String) Notion template identifier to grant access to. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `permission` (String) Permission to grant on the repository. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `role_id` (String) Optional Discord role to assign within the guild. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.
- `target_id` (String) Repository or organisation slug to grant access to. If you remove this attribute from the configuration, the API keeps the last value.

Read-Only:

- `digital_files` (Attributes) Populated digital-files payload with each file's metadata and a
short-lived presigned download URL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files))

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config.digital_files`

Read-Only:

- `external_url` (String) Optional external URL, passed through from the entitlement
configuration.
- `files` (Attributes List) One entry per attached file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files--files))
- `instructions` (String) Optional human-readable delivery instructions, passed through from
the entitlement configuration.

<a id="nestedatt--integration_config--digital_files--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integration_config.digital_files.files`

Read-Only:

- `content_type` (String) Optional content-type declared at upload. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `download_url` (String) Short-lived presigned URL for downloading the file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `expires_in` (String) Seconds until `download_url` expires. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `file_id` (String) Identifier of the attached file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `file_size` (String) Optional size of the file in bytes. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.
- `filename` (String) Original filename of the attached file. A JSON document. Use `jsonencode()` to set it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_entitlement.example
  identity = {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the entitlement.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = dodopayments_entitlement.example
  id = "<id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a entitlement by its ID.
terraform import dodopayments_entitlement.example <id>
```
